path_step: Teacher attempts to edit an existing session, making data invalid/empty, triggering an error message.
test_scenario: Verify that the system handles invalid data correctly when a teacher attempts to edit an existing session.
test_case_title: Attempt to Edit Session with Empty Title - Validation Error
pre_condition: A teacher is logged in and has access to a course with at least one existing session. The teacher is on the Course Details page, within the 'Sessions' tab, and has opened the 'Modify Session' modal for an existing session.
expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the session title cannot be empty, and the teacher remains on the session modification form.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Sessions' tab on the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Edit' button next to an existing session to open the "Modify Session" modal.
Verify that an error message 'The session title cannot be empty.' is displayed.
Verify that the 'Modify Session' modal remains open.

uncovered_conditions: AF1: Invalid Data - editing a session (specifically, empty title)
BR-SESSION-01: The session title cannot be empty.
